neighborhoods.rationale: This is where AI Tinkerers Singapore actually ran (Airwallex 3 min from Tanjong Pagar MRT Apr 2025, Cloudflare 6 min from Tanjong Pagar May 2025, Feb 2026 meetup), Lorong AI @ 22 Cross Street runs the weekly AI Wednesdays/ThursTalks/Fri-DIYs and anchored the Singapore AI Control Hackathon and bilingual Chinese builder traffic, and Microsoft Frasers Tower (182 Cecil St) hosts SG Agentic Nights and Microsoft Build //localhost with 80+ builders — walkable cluster with proven repeat bilingual dev events.
avoid_too: Marina Bay Sands / Expo halls (SuperAI, Red Hat Summit Connect) — too corporate, expo-scale, wrong vibe for 50-200 person coffee/hack
Downtown Core rooftop bars (1-Altitude, Ce La Vi) — no tables for laptops, alcohol-first venues, not hack-capable
Suntec Convention halls — convention-only, no walk-in cafe culture, expensive buyout

neighborhoods.name: Bugis / Bras Basah / Prinsep-Jalan Besar corridor
neighborhoods.rationale: Antler at 128 Prinsep St (10 min from Bugis MRT) hosted AI Tinkerers Singapore's Aug 2024 inaugural meetup and the Jun 2025 Antler x SambaNova meetup, and the same shophouse-coworking spine houses Ant International at Guoco Midtown 128 Beach Rd (AICamp 3,000+ dev community) and WeWork 380 Jalan Besar — proven 80-150 person tech-meetup capacity in indie coworking rather than hotel ballrooms.
avoid_too: Suntec City / Marina Square malls — chain cafes only, no hack-friendly seating, shopping-mall noise
National Design Centre & museum lobbies on Middle Rd — beautiful but event-only booking, no power/Wi-Fi culture
Rochor/Sim Lim Square — cheap electronics retail, no venue-grade cafes

neighborhoods.name: one-north / Ayer Rajah (BLOCK71, JTC LaunchPad, Fusionopolis, Science Park)
neighborhoods.rationale: Lorong AI's second home @ One-North runs weekly AI Wednesdays and hackathons (OpenAI Codex Hackathon Dec 2025 with 120+ builders, ROSCon Singapore Oct 2026, RoboNexus workshops), BLOCK71 at 71 Ayer Rajah Crescent runs the GenAI 2025 and AI Accelerate Microsoft cohorts and explicitly rents event space to community organizers, and nearby Geneo at 1 Science Park Drive hosted CreativeMornings x Singapore Design Week Sep 2025 while Shopee Building held the Sea x OpenAI Codex hackathon Jun 2026 — the deepest concentration of actual AI-builder infrastructure in Singapore.
avoid_too: Changi Business Park / Expo — too far east, MRT-inaccessible at night, sector-skewed to banking ops
Tuas / Jurong industrial — logistics parks only, no developer community, no cafes
Sentosa (Equarius etc.) — resort pricing, tourist crowd, wrong audience
